# CAP

> Intent-first capability discovery and consolidation for AI agents.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): human quick start and product overview
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): instructions for coding agents
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): module boundaries and data flow
- [Context Health](docs/context-health.md): pressure, funnel, V3 Value Analysis runtime (value/cost), inspect/Health contract
- [Catalog schema](data/catalog.schema.json): seed catalog contract
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

## Entry points

- CLI: `bin/cap.js` → `src/cli.js` (`setup` / `inspect` / `search` / `add` / `use` / `optimize` / `web`)
- Value Analysis: `src/profiler.js` (V3 value/cost from activity; internally the profiler module)
- MCP: `bin/cap-mcp.js` → `src/mcp-server.js` (tools from `src/mcp-tools.js`: `cap.search`, `cap.add`, `cap.use`; optional `cap.inspect`)
- Web: `cap web` → `src/web-server.js` on `127.0.0.1:4173`
- Library: `src/index.js` (`searchCapabilities`, `addCapability`, `useCapability`, `inspectLocal`, `loadCatalog`, `loadState`)

## Agent skills

- `.agents/skills/cap-develop/SKILL.md`
- `.agents/skills/add-capability/SKILL.md`
- `cap setup` writes user-level `cap-context-health` (not shipped under `.agents/skills`)

## Verify

```bash
npm run check
```
